description.p: Marco is a fast, lightweight Markdown editor built in Rust and GTK4. It pairs a source editor with a live preview, and uses a custom parser aimed at technical documentation.

A companion viewer, Polo, is available separately. It opens Markdown documents with rendering identical to the editor's preview and minimal resource use, for when you want to read a document rather than edit it. Marco does not require it, and installs on its own.

ul.li: Live preview that stays in step with the document
Full CommonMark support, plus syntax extensions for technical writing
Document outline for navigating long files
Follows the system light and dark colour scheme

description.p: Local link and image paths now resolve against the document, the preview follows the system colour scheme live, and Windows ships an Inno Setup installer alongside the portable zip.
